messages:
mia-p: Dropping a compact battlecard iteration focused on TCO + failover stories vs cloud-managed endpoints and DIY infra. Need: one defensible stat, a procurement-safe line, and inbound routing tags.

priya-k: Uploaded draft: https://redwood.internal/mkt/bcards/compact-tco (comment please). Recommend lead with a single p99 stat and a tiny appendix for repro.

sam-g: Sales ask: short soundbite for calls. If Leo can confirm p99 ratio for long prompts we can use: '~3x lower p99 on long-form prompts (internal bench)'. Link to repro.

leo-se: Bench nugget: seq=2048 p99: Redwood=760ms, CloudX=2350ms. Warm cache, batching=8, 15k samples. Repro snippet: `python bench/run.py --model redwood-opt --seq 2048 --batch 8 --requests 15000`. Use cautious phrasing.

casey-sales: Procurement-safe line: 'Managed serving + rollout controls and audit logs reduce procurement and compliance risk versus DIY GPUs.' Also propose inbound tags: onprem_interest, sla_required, procurement_cycle.

ops-bot: Reminder: book webinar slot by Tue 5pm PT if you want recording. :calendar:

mia-p: Great. Next steps: Priya tighten copy + elevator; Leo paste methodology into appendix; Casey add TCO slide + set SDR routing tags; Sam draft 8-min webinar run. Target: updated card + slide by Thu EOD. Thanks all! :rocket:
